description: The height-anchored UTXO write-proof (SPEC §8.3.3). A utxo-floor channel post carries a self-contained write_proof whose age and value gates are checked OFFLINE against the reader's OWN current tip (one tip read per render batch). The on-chain read of the outpoint itself (§8.3.3 (1): the output pays the address with the exact value at the anchor, and is unspent; one read per distinct outpoint per render batch) is out of scope for this vector. A reader checks: (a) value_sats >= utxo_floor_sats; (b) age = current_tip_height - anchor_block_height + 1 >= utxo_floor_confs; (c) control_sig BIP-322 by the UTXO address over post_id. Any failure ⇒ E_CHAN_FLOOR. Proves the arithmetic of the age gate for a clearing and a below-floor proof.
notes: age_confs = current_tip_height - anchor_block_height + 1. clears: 800200-800000+1 = 201 >= 144 AND value 50000 >= 10000 ⇒ accept. below_floor_age: 800200-800180+1 = 21 < 144 ⇒ E_CHAN_FLOOR. below_floor_value: age clears but value 5000 < 10000 ⇒ E_CHAN_FLOOR. control_sig (BIP-322 over post_id by the outpoint's controlling address) is also required but is out of scope for this arithmetic vector.
